description: This file defines a function to retrieve the top purchase orders for display in a list view, specific to the PurchaseOrder module in the SugarCRM-derived system. It includes logic for constructing database queries, handling custom views, and generating list view headers and entries, as well as a search filter for purchase orders due today assigned to the current user.

methods.name: getTopPurchaseOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the top N purchase orders based on maximum entries specified, applying custom view filters, sorting, and search criteria, then formats data for list view display including header and entries.

methods.name: getTopPurchaseOrderSearch
methods.description: Enhances the search criteria for purchase orders to filter for those due today and assigned to the current user, returning modified search parameters.
